_comment: A bounty rule packet in Fine Print's content model (ruleSource / clause / conflict). Fictional demo bounty. Clause `normalized` JSON is what code computes on; `quote` is what humans read.

bounty.title: Write a Solana escrow explainer (demo bounty)

ruleSources.title: Bounty Terms
ruleSources.precedenceQuote: If the listing and these Terms disagree, these Terms govern.

clauses.quote: The reward is 1 SOL, held in escrow and paid only to the invited contributor.
This bounty is offered to one invited contributor, identified by their wallet address.
The invited contributor must accept these Terms by October 5, 2026, 11:59 PM PT.
Submissions must be received by October 12, 2026, 11:59 PM PT.
The Sponsor will approve or decline the submission by October 19, 2026, 11:59 PM PT.
If the work is not approved by the review date, or a deadline passes before the next step, the reward returns to the Sponsor.
Approval is at the Sponsor's sole discretion.

conflicts.title: Listing says Oct 14, Terms say Oct 12, 11:59 PM PT
conflicts.rationale: The listing shows a later, date-only deadline. The Terms govern on conflict, but the sponsor must confirm which instant executes before funding.
